ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two voltage-reducing circuits, one above and one below. The upper title is Linear voltage-reducing circuit; the lower title is Switching voltage-reducing circuit. The power supply on the left side of the lower switching voltage-reducing circuit is labeled 13.5 V, the load end is labeled 5 V at load, the red arrow labels the load current I_load = 240 mA, and the average supply current I_supply is marked as unknown. Reasoning: According to the problem-specified ideal switching converter assumption, the input power equals the output load power. Output power P_out = V_out × I_load = 5 V × 0.240 A = 1.2 W. Average supply current I_supply = P_in / V_in = 1.2 W / 13.5 V = 0.088888... A = 88.888... mA. Keeping one decimal place gives 88.9 mA.

method.method_draft: Recognize the bottom circuit as an ideal buck converter. Use the voltage conversion ratio to find the switch duty cycle, D = 5/13.5. Since the source current is drawn only during the switch-on interval and is approximately the inductor/load current during that interval, multiply the load current 240 mA by D. Round the resulting average supply current to one decimal place.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有两个降压电路。上方是“Linear voltage-reducing circuit”，标注电源为 13.5 V，负载端为 5 V，负载电流 I_load = 240 mA，供应电流 I_supply 未知。下方是“Switching voltage-reducing circuit”，包含驱动电路、开关器件、二极管、电感、电容和负载，同样标注电源为 13.5 V，负载端为 5 V，负载电流 I_load = 240 mA，要求求该开关降压电路的平均 I_supply。
推理：按理想 buck 降压变换器处理，输出电压与输入电压关系为 V_out = D V_in。因此占空比 D = 5 / 13.5 = 0.37037。电源电流只在开关导通期间从电源流入，导通时近似等于负载/电感平均电流 240 mA，所以平均电源电流 I_supply = D × I_load = 0.37037 × 240 mA = 88.888... mA。四舍五入到一位小数为 88.9 mA。
